selection: Among complete dev arms minimize mean external-arrival-to-completion time; ties use higher cap.
fixed_baseline_claim_scope: The selected cap is the mean-flow choice, not necessarily the best complete-service or joint-SLO baseline. All three fixed-cap raw distributions and the full exploratory SLO surface remain comparators; any benefit claim must inspect them, including TTFT tails and natural output amounts, rather than only the selected mean-flow arm.
